I will put one bag of NPK and one bag of urea that I got from the subsidy on this field, because last year my neighbor who did this filled her granary while mine was half empty. I will also spread the manure I collected from my goats and chickens, since this land belongs to me and I want it to stay strong for my grandchildren. I am planting the maize seed I kept from last season, not the new kind from the agro-dealer, because I know this seed and I do not have cash to lose if the new one fails. My daughters and their children will help me with the digging and weeding, but I will need to hire two young men for a few days when the weeds are tall because these old bones cannot work from sunrise to sunset anymore.
